profile.name: ECMA-376 Transitional DOCX bounded relationship/story/layout profile
profile.conformanceClass: Transitional package with explicit preserve-or-diagnose policy
profile.profileBoundary: OPC parts and relationships, WordprocessingML stories, bounded structure/style/layout, unsupported occurrence accounting, and security limits

oracle.identity: literal authored OOXML source facts plus independent ZIP/XML enumeration
oracle.sourceKind: synthetic/standards-focused DOCX vectors; no converter output is used to author expected values
oracle.externalFetchPolicy: never fetch external relationship targets; external and missing targets remain unavailable

producerPolicy.description: Every checked-in fixture is synthetic and standards-focused. It is not a Word, LibreOffice, or Google Docs export.
requiredRealProducers: Microsoft Word for Mac or Word Online

requirements.description: Every authored DOCX profile case must compare the public converter IR with the independent ZIP/XML oracle at zero mismatch.
requirements.gate: all positive profile, closure, story, structure, style-layout, accounting, resource, and security assertions pass

requirements.description: Every authored negative mutation must be detected by the qualification comparison.
requirements.gate: negativeMutationFailureCount equals zero in every report

requirements.description: The bounded profile must be exercised against the required independent producer families before it can qualify.
requirements.gate: realProducerCorpusCount is at least the number of requiredRealProducers

requirements.description: The multi-producer report must contain an independently authored differential corpus rather than synthetic-only fixtures.
requirements.gate: producer.synthetic-differential-zero passes with real producer fixtures present

requirements.description: No report may claim a qualified profile while any mismatch, unaccounted occurrence, unsupported loss, false completion, or missing producer evidence remains.
requirements.gate: status is passed only when all selected assertions, negative mutations, and producer gates pass

unmetRequirements: DOCX99-REAL-PRODUCERS: 0 real producer fixture families are available; 4 are required.
DOCX99-DIFFERENTIAL: no Microsoft Word, Word Online/Mac, LibreOffice, or Google Docs authored export is present for differential qualification.
DOCX99-DEPENDENCIES: dependent issue qualification evidence is not bundled into this bounded lane and must be verified before issue #99 completion.

fixtures.provenance: authored for issue #99; not emitted by a converter or real producer
